review.method: Visual review with local Whisper transcript support

steps.title: Enable Cat-a-lot
steps.instruction: Open user preferences, select Gadgets, enable Cat-a-lot, and save the change.

steps.title: Open the category tool
steps.instruction: Open a Commons category and select the Cat-a-lot link.

steps.title: Select the files
steps.instruction: Select individual files or use Shift to select a file range.

steps.title: Move the files
steps.instruction: Select the destination category and use Move to change the file categories.

steps.title: Verify the move
steps.instruction: Refresh both categories and verify that the files moved.

steps.title: Search for another category
steps.instruction: Enter a category name and select a matching destination from the results.
